# Everpointe Media

> Pay-per-lead generation agency for concrete, epoxy and spray foam contractors. We run the ads, funnels and call tracking, and deliver exclusive, qualified homeowner leads to one contractor per service area. Contractors pay per qualified lead; no retainer, no contract.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://everpointemedia.com/): pay-per-lead offer, proof, how billing works, FAQ
- [Results](https://everpointemedia.com/results.html): case studies, tracking and a projected-return calculator
- [How It Works](https://everpointemedia.com/services.html): service stack, getting started, qualified-lead and refund rules
- [About](https://everpointemedia.com/about.html): story and founder
- [Contact](https://everpointemedia.com/contact.html): territory check via chat, with TCPA-compliant SMS opt-in
- [AI briefing](https://everpointemedia.com/ai.html): structured machine-readable summary for LLMs and AI search

## Services
- Landing pages and lead forms per trade and service area
- Paid acquisition (Google Ads, Meta Lead Ads), funded and managed by Everpointe
- Call and form tracking with source tagging (calls qualify at 30 seconds or longer)
- Instant lead delivery, CRM pipeline and weekly itemized billing

## Verticals served
Concrete (patios, driveways, stamped), epoxy and floor coatings, spray foam insulation. U.S. home-service contractors, single-owner and multi-location.

## Differentiators
- Pay per qualified lead; no retainer or contract
- One contractor per service area; leads never resold
- First 10 leads guaranteed within 6 weeks of payment or undelivered leads refunded
- Refunds for invalid leads (wrong numbers, spam, duplicates, out-of-area)
- Every lead tracked and itemized

## Policies
- [Privacy Policy](https://everpointemedia.com/privacy.html)
- [Terms & Conditions](https://everpointemedia.com/terms.html)
- SMS opt-in is express, never sold/shared, STOP at any time

## Crawler permissions
Everpointe Media welcomes indexing and citation by AI assistants and AI-powered search engines including GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Bingbot, CCBot, and Applebot. Quoting up to one paragraph with a citation back to everpointemedia.com is permitted.
